subject: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS064]
text: Near the cliff above the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern on Death Mountain Trail, smash the red boulder with the Megaton Hammer to find a Gold Skulltula underneath.

evidence.quote:
Head for the red boulder, near the bomb flower that you used to blow open the
entrance to Dodongo's Cavern.  Smash the boulder with the Megaton Hammer.   The
Gold Skulltula is underneath it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS065]
text: On the portion of Death Mountain Trail where burning rocks pelt Link, smash the last of the three boulders to reveal a Gold Skulltula underneath.

evidence.quote:
Smash the last of the three boulders on the way up the portion of Death
Mountain Trail where you are pelted with burning rocks.  The Gold Skulltula
lies underneath it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS023]
text: Inside the Death Mountain Crater entrance at the top of Death Mountain Trail, smash into the two crates on the left to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Use the entrance to Death Mountain Crater at the top of Death Mountain Trail.
As you enter, there are two crates to the left.  Smash into them.  One of them
contains the Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS058]
text: Warp to the lower half of Death Mountain Crater by playing the Bolero of Fire as Young Link, drop a Bottled Bug into the soft earth patch to the left, and defeat the Gold Skulltula that emerges.

evidence.quote:
As Young Link, play the Bolero of Fire to warp to the lower half of Death
Mountain Crater.  As you arrive, look to the left of the warp-in point to see a
patch of soft earth.  Drop a Bottled Bug into it, and kill the Gold Skulltula
that appears.

subject: Boulder room
text: From the entrance of Goron City, head left to a barrier of boulders, blow open a path with a bomb, and proceed through the tunnel behind and to the left.

evidence.quote:
Go to the left from the entrance until you reach a barrier of boulders.  Use a
bomb to blow open a path, and go through the tunnel behind and to the left of
the boulders.

subject: Rock maze
text: To navigate the rock maze in Goron City, destroy the brown rock on the right upon entering, destroy the brown rock behind it, walk through the gap, destroy the brown rock on the left, proceed right through the new opening, and destroy the brown stone directly ahead.

evidence.quote:
Destroy the brown rock to your right as
you enter the "rock maze," then the brown rock behind it.  Go through the gap
you have created, and destroy the brown rock on the left.  Go through the new
gap, and take a right.  Destroy the brown stone directly in front of you, and
you will reach the end of the "maze."

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS022]
text: In the corner of the small enclosure at the end of the rock maze in Goron City, roll into the crate to reveal the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In the corner of this small enclosure,  there is a crate.  Roll into it to reveal the Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS056]
text: Stand on one of the ropes holding up the suspended central platform in Goron City to spot the Gold Skulltula on the back of the platform, then defeat it and retrieve its token with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Head for one of the ropes that hold up the platform suspended above the middle
of the room.  Stand on the rope so that you can see the back of the platform,
where there is a Gold Skulltula visible.  Kill it and take it's token with the
Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS024]
text: Roll into the tree located to the left of the stone wall near the entrance to Zora's River to knock down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Roll into the tree to the left of the stone wall near the entrance to Zora's
River.  A Gold Skulltula will fall from the tree and land near you.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS025]
text: Near the entrance to Zora's Domain, jump into the shallow river, shoot the Gold Skulltula on the ladder dipping into the water with the Slingshot, and climb the ladder to collect its token.

evidence.quote:
Head upstream to the entrance to Zora's Domain.  Near the bottom of the land
bridges, there is a ladder which dips down into the river.  The Gold Skulltula
sits on this ladder.  Jump down into the shallow part of the river, and shoot
the Skulltula with the Slingshot before climbing up the ladder to take it's
token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS066]
text: Near where Link jumps across Zora's River for the second time, shoot the Gold Skulltula high on the south wall with the Longshot, or climb to the upper ledge if using the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Near the part of the river where you jump over it for the second time, there is
a Gold Skulltula high on the south wall.  You can shoot it from there with the
Longshot, but if you still have only the Hookshot then you'll have to climb up
to the upper ledge to reach it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS067]
text: Just past the wooden bridge near the east side of Zora's River and around the corner, use the Hookshot to defeat the Gold Skulltula high on the northwest wall and collect its token.

evidence.quote:
Run to the end of the wooden bridge near the east side of Zora's River.  Just
past the wooden bridge and around the corner, the Gold Skulltula sits high on
the northwest wall.  Use the Hookshot to kill it and take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS068]
text: Climb to the top of the frozen waterfall using the tunnel on the left side of King Zora's throne room, walk to the edge, and use the Hookshot to defeat the Gold Skulltula on the left wall to get its token.

evidence.quote:
Climb up to the top of the frozen waterfall using the tunnel in the left side
of King Zora's throne room.  Edge to the edge of the waterfall, and look on the
wall on the left side to see the Gold Skulltula.  Use the Hookshot to kill it
and take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS034]
text: Climb onto the giant tree branch resting in the water in Zora's Fountain, defeat the Gold Skulltula on the wall to the west, and retrieve its token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Climb up onto the tree branch, and look on the wall to the west of the tree
branch to see the Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and use the Boomerang to get it's
token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS029]
text: Roll into the single tree on the island in the southeast of Zora's Fountain to make a Gold Skulltula drop from its branches.

evidence.quote:
Roll into the single tree on the island in the southeast of the area.  The
Skulltula will fall from the branches, landing near you.
